actions.name: delete_rows
actions.title: Delete rows
actions.description: Delete rows in a table in IBM Db2
actions.help: Delete one or more rows in any table that matches a filter. First select the table, then specify the WHERE condition to filter the row(s) to delete.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be deleted, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes)

actions.name: export_csv_v2
actions.title: Export query result
actions.description: Export query result as a CSV file in IBM Db2
actions.help: This action executes a SQL query and exports the result into a CSV file. This action is intended to write SQL(SELECT) queries.

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Export the results of this SQL (SELECT) query.

input.name: delimiter
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The delimiter character that separates each column in the CSV file. CSV files typically use comma .

input.name: target_url
input.label: Upload URL
input.hint: Export the CSV file to this URL. Use the output of Generate on-prem file URL or an S3 presigned URL (with PUT method).

actions.name: insert_rows_batch
actions.title: Insert rows
actions.description: Insert batch of rows in a table in IBM Db2
actions.help: Inserts a batch of rows in the selected table. Select the table, then provide data for the rows.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

actions.name: search_rows
actions.title: Select rows
actions.description: Select rows in a table in IBM Db2
actions.help: Select rows from the selected table/view that match your WHERE condition. Result is limited to 50000 rows.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: output_columns
input.label: Output columns
input.hint: Choose columns to be selected from the table. Default is to return all columns.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be selected, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes). Use bind variables, e.g. id = :id , and the parameter field to parameterize inputs.

input.name: parameters
input.label: Parameters
input.hint: First provide the full name assigned to your bind variable in the WHERE condition. e.g. id Second, provide the actual parameter value. Parameter values can be static or datapills. Select the closest c…

input.name: orderby
input.label: Order by
input.hint: Order of rows to return. e.g. updated_at DESC

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Max number of rows to return. Limit is 50000 and default is 100.

input.name: offset
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Number of rows to skip. e.g. 100 .

actions.name: upsert_rows_batch
actions.title: Upsert rows
actions.description: Upsert batch of rows in a table in IBM Db2
actions.help: Inserts/updates a batch of rows in the selected table by the specified unique key. Select the table, then provide data for the rows. Rows with unique key values found will be updated with the data provided. Rows without existing unique key values will be created with data provided.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.
